description: This file defines an interface class 'IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper' for managing protection metadata in a GStreamer buffer within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It declares methods for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata associated with GstBuffer objects.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper
classes.description: An interface class providing methods to manage protection metadata on GstBuffer objects.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Retrieves protection metadata data from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Removes protection metadata from a GstBuffer.
